article.story: ASHEVILLE, N.C. -- — Jaxon Prunty had 19 points in Western Carolina’s 83-75 win against UNC Asheville on Saturday. Prunty shot 3 of 12 from the field, including 3 for 9 from 3-point range, and went 10 for 11 from the line for the Catamounts (1-1). Jaeden Roberts scored 17 points, shooting 5 for 9 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line. Malachi Brown had 16 points and shot 4 of 7 from the field, including 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 8 from the line. Connor Dubsky finished with 16 points and three steals for the Bulldogs (1-2). UNC Asheville also got 15 points and eight rebounds from Ja’Corey Lipkins. Jermaurhiyun Anderson finished with 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
